descriptions.photo: Look at pictures together, one at a time, and talk about anything they bring to mind.
descriptions.object: Visit everyday objects in the room, one at a time, and talk about them if you like.
descriptions.sound: Listen to familiar sounds, and talk about anything they bring to mind.
descriptions.space: Look around the whole room at your own pace. Choose anything that catches your eye.
descriptions.sequence: A short, gentle tour of pictures, objects and sounds, in an order set up in advance.
